question: How and where should Brahma be worshipped in this ritual arrangement?
premises: Worship is performed with scent, flowers, and other offerings.
Brahma is the deity to be worshipped.
The worship takes place on the right side.
inference: After offering scent and flowers, one should worship Brahma on the right side.
plain_english: Having worshipped with scent, flowers, and other offerings, one should worship Brahma on the right side.
